verdict: key consistent: 75 signs = 75 letters, 18 groups = 18 words, one letter per shape; ا has two shapes (S7 ٢, S17 ٣ once), ي two (S3 bar, S19 curled bar once)
notes: Rows: 8v l.9-13 and 9r l.1 (the 7-sign row on 9r is the end of the verse, بلا طبيب, not a separate item). Measured 16+12+14+12+14+7 = 75 signs (record 83) and 18 dividers (record 19); 8v l.9 has, between الشباب and بدمع, an erased sign and an erased divider (faint ink, z_l9faint.png), not counted: the 'about 3 faint unboxed signs' of the record are this erasure. All words fit their groups with no surplus or dropped letter; لا in لاني and بلا is two signs (S6 S7), no lam-alif sign. The numeral-like signs: ٢ = ا, ٣ = ا (once, in كالممات), ٩ = ل, ٩ with a hook = د.
